english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for inspecting or looking into something, such as checking your car oil.
This is the all-purpose verb for examining or checking something.
This is the casual all-purpose choice for looking into or checking something.
Use 查 when “dig” means to investigate or research, including looking for evidence or information.

examples.english: I want to check the car's oil.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 caa4 haa5 gaa3 ce1 ge3 jau4

examples.english: Can you exam the paper to see whether any questions were missed?
examples.traditional: 你幫我查吓份卷有冇漏題。
examples.jyutping: nei5 bong1 ngo5 caa4 haa5 fan6 gyun2 jau5 mou5 lau6 tai4

examples.english: Let me investigate first; maybe the machine is just out of power.
examples.traditional: 等我查吓先，可能部機只係冇電。
examples.jyutping: dang2 ngo5 caa4 haa5 sin1 ho2 nang4 bou6 gei1 zi2 hai6 mou5 din6

examples.english: I’ll dig into this matter and get to the bottom of it.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 wui5 caa4 cing1 co2 gin6 si6
